hook: A 1939 Erdős and Mahler conjecture is false. Numbers exist with infinitely many 2^a/3^b convergents.
hook_turn: Numbers exist with infinitely many 2^a/3^b convergents.
summary: The author builds, for every real tau at least 4, a Cantor set of numbers with irrationality exponent tau, each having infinitely many continued-fraction convergents of the form 2^a/3^b. This gives a counterexample to the conjecture. The construction works only for tau of 4 or more, so smaller exponents are not covered by this result.
title: A counterexample to the Erd\H{o}s--Mahler conjecture
